resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO
resources.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; used for self-consistent calculation and band structure.

resources.name: PseudoDojo norm-conserving pseudopotential for Mg (LDA)
resources.notes: Norm-conserving LDA pseudopotential for Mg, available from the PseudoDojo library.

resources.name: Crystallographic data for hcp Mg

access.notes: Standard hexagonal close-packed lattice parameters: a = 3.2094 Å, c = 5.2105 Å (e.g., Pearson's Handbook of Crystallographic Data). The agent must construct the input structure (atomic positions: Mg at (1/3,2/3,1/4) and (2/3,1/3,3/4) in fractional coordinates) using these lattice constants.

resources.notes: The agent constructs the structure from known parameters; no downloadable file is required.

resources.name: Optical conductivity post-processing (epsilon.x or custom script)

access.package: epsilon.x is distributed with Quantum ESPRESSO

resources.notes: The agent must compute the interband conductivity contributions from Kohn-Sham eigenvalues and dipole matrix elements.
